<pasted_content id="21ab">
You are the lead integration engineer for this repository (Atira EHL "RFQ to bid" agent, Python 3.12 + uv, swarm in swarm/ and agents/). Read CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, docs/COLLABORATION.md, docs/INTEGRATION.md, docs/SWARM.md first and follow them (scripts/team.py status --json, tests/test_contracts.py, commit from PowerShell, never push entire/* or .swarm/ or .integration/).

GOAL
Create branch `first_100` from `origin/lean/browse` (the first branch that reached quality 100 on the public dataset; it is the proven baseline and must stay at quality 100). Then make `first_100` better, without regressing it, by:
  1. finding what does NOT work properly or is weak in `main`'s line of work (and in lean/browse itself): failures, wasted time, step exhaustion, flaky parts, rules in the brief that are not covered, robustness gaps for the PRIVATE dataset (different layouts/names/data);
  2. finding which of those problems another branch already solves, or which improvements it contains that lean/browse lacks;
  3. porting exactly those improvements into `first_100`, one small commit each, tested.

ACTIVE LINES OF WORK (inspect all; verify with `git fetch --all --prune` and `git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...<branch>`; ignore stale ones after checking they add nothing)
  - origin/main (shared baseline; currently BEHIND several branches)
  - origin/lean/browse (quality 100 baseline -> base of first_100)
  - origin/claude/funny-allen-z0iuyw (kurk-s, newest, ~46 commits ahead of main)
  - origin/kurk-s/mail-topics (mail topic tabs)
  - local someimprovementsidk (mine; price index from newest message, tab scheduler, browser speed/signing fixes, docs/IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md)
  Older/other: site-recon, tanreader-debug, tender_portal, test_brief_reader, integration/next, dev, website-parsing, start_from_beginningiamcooked. Check them only for unique ideas.

METHOD
  1. Preserve state: do not touch uncommitted work (docs/IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md is untracked). Use `git worktree add .swarm/wt/<name> <ref>` (git-ignored) for inspection; never edit another agent's worktree. Create first_100 in its own worktree: `git worktree add ../first_100 -b first_100 origin/lean/browse`.
  2. Weakness list: read lean/browse's run logs in .swarm/runs/ (INDEX.md first, then the *-log.md files; pull missing ones with scripts/pull-run.ps1 only for runs that are mine) and the memory notes (ERP step exhaustion, strict matcher, early COLLECT exit, mail duplicates, log truncation). Compare against the 29 bid rules in the brief. Produce a table: problem | evidence | where it lives | fixed in which branch | status.
  3. Branch comparison: for each other line, `git log first_100..<branch>` and `git diff first_100...<branch> --stat`, read the diffs, and classify every change: complementary / already in first_100 / duplicates / conflicts (textual or semantic: same function, different assumptions) / dangerous (hardcoded scenario values, fixed click paths, helpers that crawl the sites: these violate fair play and must NOT be ported).
  4. Port only changes that fix a listed weakness. Prefer cherry-pick of a single commit or a hand-merged hunk; never blind-merge a whole branch; never accept one side automatically; resolve by intent and test results. Where two implementations solve the same problem keep the one that works on first_100 and note why.
  5. After EACH port: `uv run --no-sync python -m pytest tests -q`, then a local check (`scripts/local-run.ps1 -Only "..." -Name x`, needs `atira models proxy` running) when the change touches site navigation. Before declaring a port good, a sandbox `atira test-run . --follow` must keep quality 100 (compare with lean/browse's run; keep time/cost no worse). If quality drops, revert that port and record it as rejected.
  6. Fair play check on the final diff vs lean/browse: no scenario values (prices, material numbers, tender refs, TANs, logins) in code/prompts/config, no fixed click paths, model still chooses navigation, max 4 browsers, submit ~1 min before end. Run the repo's contract tests.

CONSTRAINTS
  - Preserve all existing work and history; no force-push, no deleting branches, no pushing to main (the integrator moves it), no pushing first_100 or running `atira submit` without asking me first.
  - Do not read or print .env or keys. Commit via PowerShell; end commit messages with the Co-Authored-By line from the session attribution.
  - Do not claim anything works until the tests/run actually passed; separate passed / failed / not run.
  - Save every pulled run log/MCP result to .swarm/runs/ and update .swarm/runs/INDEX.md. Never copy values from logs into the package.

DELIVERABLE (final message)
  1. Weakness table (problem, evidence, fix source).
  2. Per-branch: what was ported into first_100 (commit hashes), what was rejected and why, what remains unresolved.
  3. Test results: unit tests, local checks, sandbox test-run id with quality/time/cost vs lean/browse.
  4. Risks for the private dataset and the smallest next step.
  5. Exact commands for me to push first_100 and for teammates to adopt it.
</pasted_content id="21ab">

1	"""Lean browsing: the model decides, code does the mechanics. A drop-in for `browser_agent.browse()`.
2	
3	browse() runs a browser-use agent: the model locates element indexes, drags sliders and retries clicks itself, at
4	3-5 s and one model call per click (400-550 calls per sandbox run). Here each step is: code clears the page (the
5	PopupGuard: cookie walls, notices, error pages, robot gates), turns it into compact text plus numbered elements (links
6	with their hrefs, buttons, fields, iframes and open shadow roots included), and asks the model ONE question: what to
7	do on this page. The model still chooses where to go, what to search for and what to save (fair play); code only
8	clicks, types, reads and saves what it chose.
9	
10	The reply uses the same action names as the browser-use agents, so the scrapers' job prompts stay valid:
11	{"memory": "...", "action": [{"click": {"index": 3}}, {"read_page": {"topic": "..."}}, ...]}.
12	Pages are driven with Playwright over CDP on the run's browsers (locally: one Chromium, a context per browser).
13	"""
14	from __future__ import annotations
15	
16	import asyncio
17	import base64
18	import json
19	import logging
20	import os
21	import weakref
22	from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse
23	
24	import browsers
25	from swarm import timeline
26	from swarm.browser_agent import PAGE_TEXT_LIMIT, RecordParams, Tab, allowed_domains, main_tab, normalize_actions, \
27	    site_tips
28	from swarm.forms import fill_fields, scoped_evaluator
29	from swarm.guard import PopupGuard
30	from swarm.page_text import EXTRACT_JS, FRAME_MISSING, NEXT_JS, clean
31	
32	log = logging.getLogger("lean")
33	
34	MODEL_TIMEOUT_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_LEAN_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S", "45"))
35	ACTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000
36	ACTION_BUDGET_S = 60         # one action at most (a read of a paged list included)
37	TEXT_LIMIT = 7000            # page text shown to the model per step
38	ELEMENT_LIMIT = 180          # numbered elements shown per step (new ones first)
39	MAX_ACTIONS = 5              # actions per reply

73	# Runs in a frame: (offset) => elements. Numbers the visible interactive elements (open shadow roots included) and
74	# tags each with data-lean-id so a locator finds it again.
75	ELEMENTS_JS = r"""(offset) => {
76	  const norm = s => (s || '').replace(/[​-‍⁠﻿]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
77	  const shown = el => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const s = getComputedStyle(el);
78	    return (r.width > 0 || r.height > 0) && s.visibility !== 'hidden' && s.display !== 'none'; };
79	  const roots = [document];
80	  for (let i = 0; i < roots.length && i < 40; i++) for (const el of roots[i].querySelectorAll('*')) if (el.shadowRoot) roots.push(el.shadowRoot);
81	  for (const root of roots) for (const el of root.querySelectorAll('[data-lean-id]')) el.removeAttribute('data-lean-id');
82	  const sel = 'a[href], button, input:not([type=hidden]), select, textarea, summary, [role=button], [role=link], [role=tab], [role=menuitem], [role=checkbox], [role=slider], [role=option]';
83	  const out = []; let n = offset;
84	  for (const root of roots) for (const el of root.querySelectorAll(sel)) {
85	    if (out.length >= 400) break;
86	    const kind = (el.type || '').toLowerCase();
87	    if (!shown(el) && !['checkbox', 'radio', 'range'].includes(kind)) continue;
88	    el.setAttribute('data-lean-id', String(n));
89	    const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
90	    const label = norm(el.getAttribute('aria-label') || (el.labels && el.labels[0] && el.labels[0].innerText) ||
91	      el.placeholder || el.title || el.innerText || (tag === 'input' ? '' : el.value) || el.name || el.id || '').slice(0, 80);
92	    const item = {id: n, tag, label};
93	    if (kind) item.type = kind;
94	    if (tag === 'a') item.href = el.getAttribute('href');
95	    if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea') {
96	      if (kind === 'checkbox' || kind === 'radio') item.checked = el.checked;
97	      else item.value = norm(el.value).slice(0, 60);
98	      if (kind === 'range') { item.min = el.min || '0'; item.max = el.max || '100'; }
99	    }
100	    if (tag === 'select') { item.value = el.value; item.options = [...el.options].slice(0, 15).map(o => norm(o.text)); }
101	    if (el.disabled) item.disabled = true;
102	    out.push(item); n++;
103	  }
104	  return out;
105	}"""

107	SLIDERS_JS = r"""() => [...document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]')]
108	  .filter(r => (r.offsetWidth || r.offsetHeight) && !r.disabled && Number(r.value) < Number(r.max || 100))
109	  .map(r => { r.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); const b = r.getBoundingClientRect();
110	              return [b.left + 3, b.right - 2, b.top + b.height / 2]; })"""

153	async def _context(index: int):
154	    """Browser `index`'s context: over CDP in a run; locally one Chromium with a context per browser index.
155	    A browser that does not answer within 30 s raises (the caller falls back to another one)."""
156	    global _PW, _LOCAL
157	    async with _LOCK:
158	        if _PW is None:
159	            from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
160	            _PW = await async_playwright().start()
161	    async with _INDEX_LOCKS.setdefault(index, asyncio.Lock()):
162	        if index in _CONTEXTS:
163	            return _CONTEXTS[index]
164	        urls = browsers.cdp_urls()
165	        if urls:
166	            browser = await asyncio.wait_for(_PW.chromium.connect_over_cdp(urls[index % len(urls)]), 30)
167	            context = browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else await browser.new_context()
168	        else:
169	            async with _LOCK:
170	                if _LOCAL is None:
171	                    _LOCAL = await _PW.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS") == "1")
172	            context = await _LOCAL.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 800})
173	        try:        # a tab we opened can close itself (one history entry); only real popups may
174	            await context.add_init_script(KEEP_OPEN_JS)
175	        except Exception as error:
176	            log.debug("init script: %s", error)
177	        _CONTEXTS[index] = context
178	        return context

181	async def page_for(tab: Tab):
182	    """The page `tab` works in: kept across browse calls (logged in, current page), created on first use."""
183	    page = _PAGES.get(tab)
184	    if page is not None and not page.is_closed():
185	        return page
186	    count = max(1, len(browsers.cdp_urls()))
187	    context, use_main = None, tab.main
188	    for shift in range(count):                       # a browser that does not answer: the next one
189	        index = (tab.browser + shift) % count
190	        try:
191	            context = await _context(index)
192	            break
193	        except Exception as error:
194	            log.warning("browser %d not usable (%s); trying the next one", index, type(error).__name__)
195	            use_main = False
196	    if context is None:
197	        raise RuntimeError("no browser answers")
198	    if use_main and browsers.cdp_urls() and context.pages:
199	        page = context.pages[0]
200	    else:
201	        page = await asyncio.wait_for(context.new_page(), 20)
202	        if browsers.cdp_urls():         # so Tab.close() closes it like a browser-use tab
203	            try:
204	                session = await context.new_cdp_session(page)
205	                info = await session.send("Target.getTargetInfo")
206	                tab.claim(info["targetInfo"]["targetId"])
207	                await session.detach()
208	            except Exception as error:
209	                log.debug("target id: %s", error)
210	    _PAGES[tab] = page
211	    return page

231	async def elements(page) -> tuple[list[dict], dict[int, object]]:
232	    """Numbered interactive elements of the page and its frames; id -> frame for the locator."""
233	    found, where = [], {}
234	    for frame in page.frames:

245	def order_elements(items: list[dict], seen: set) -> tuple[list[dict], set]:
246	    """Elements that appeared since the last step first (an opened menu, a dialog, results), marked NEW; capped."""
247	    keys = [(e.get("tag"), e.get("label"), e.get("href")) for e in items]
248	    fresh = [e for e, k in zip(items, keys) if seen and k not in seen]
249	    for e in fresh:
250	        e["new"] = True
251	    rest = [e for e, k in zip(items, keys) if not (seen and k not in seen)]
252	    return (fresh + rest)[:ELEMENT_LIMIT], set(keys)

255	def element_lines(items: list[dict]) -> str:
256	    lines = []
257	    for e in items:
258	        line = f"[{e['id']}] {e['tag']}{'/' + e['type'] if e.get('type') else ''} \"{e.get('label', '')}\""
259	        if e.get("href"):
260	            line += f" -> {e['href'][:120]}"
261	        if "value" in e and e["value"] not in ("", None):
262	            line += f" value=\"{e['value']}\""
263	        if "checked" in e:
264	            line += f" checked={str(e['checked']).lower()}"
265	        if e.get("type") == "range":
266	            line += f" range {e.get('min')}..{e.get('max')}"
267	        if e.get("options"):
268	            line += f" options={e['options']}"
269	        if e.get("disabled"):
270	            line += " disabled"
271	        if e.get("new"):
272	            line += "  NEW"
273	        lines.append(line)
274	    return "\n".join(lines)

303	async def lean_browse(ctx, goal: str, *, browser: int = 0, tab: Tab | None = None, site_id: str = "", on_record=None,
304	                      max_steps: int = 40, hints: str = "", author: str = "lean", stop_reserve: float | None = None,
305	                      stop_extra: float = 0.0, careful: bool = False, idle_steps: int | None = None,
306	                      stop_on_record: str = "", extra_actions: dict | None = None, **_ignored) -> dict:
307	    """Same contract as browser_agent.browse(): {"summary", "records", "steps", "done", ...}.
308	
309	    extra_actions: {name: (one-line help, async fn(params, page) -> str | (str, finish))}: job-specific tools the
310	    model may call like the built-in actions; finish=True ends the browse as done."""
311	    token = timeline.AGENT.set(author)
312	    started = timeline.now()
313	    try:
314	        out = await _lean(ctx, goal, browser=browser, tab=tab, site_id=site_id, on_record=on_record,
315	                          max_steps=max_steps, hints=hints, author=author, stop_reserve=stop_reserve,
316	                          stop_extra=stop_extra, careful=careful, idle_steps=idle_steps, stop_on_record=stop_on_record,
317	                          extra_actions=extra_actions or {})
318	        if not out.get("done"):
319	            timeline.add("browse.failed", out.get("summary", "")[:60], started)
320	        return out
321	    finally:
322	        timeline.AGENT.reset(token)

325	async def _lean(ctx, goal, *, browser, tab, site_id, on_record, max_steps, hints, author, stop_reserve, stop_extra,
326	                careful, idle_steps, stop_on_record, extra_actions) -> dict:
327	    records: list[dict] = []
328	    state = {"saved_at": None, "steps": 0}
329	    tab = tab or main_tab(browser)
330	    page = await asyncio.wait_for(page_for(tab), 75)
331	    log.info("%s: working in %s", author, page.url[:80] or "a new tab")
332	    task = ctx.task if ctx is not None else {}
333	    secrets = [str((s.get("credentials") or {}).get("password") or "") for s in (task.get("access") or [])]
334	
335	    def reserve() -> float:
336	        if stop_reserve is not None:
337	            return stop_reserve
338	        return ctx.stop_at(stop_extra) if ctx is not None and hasattr(ctx, "stop_at") else stop_extra
339	
340	    def mask(text: str) -> str:
341	        for secret in secrets:
342	            if len(secret) >= 4:
343	                text = text.replace(secret, "***")
344	        return text
345	
346	    async def emit(rec: dict) -> None:
347	        records.append(rec)
348	        state["saved_at"] = state["steps"]
349	        if on_record:
350	            await on_record(rec)
351	
352	    async def evaluate(js, *args):
353	        return await page.evaluate(js, *args)
354	
355	    async def guard_fill(pairs, then_click, item_id):
356	        await drag_sliders(page)
357	        return await fill_fields(scoped_evaluator(evaluate, item_id), pairs, "", then_click)
358	
359	    guard = PopupGuard(ctx, author, careful=careful, fill=guard_fill)

361	    hint_text = hints + ("\nTips from other agents on this site:\n- " + "\n- ".join(tips) if tips else "")
362	    if extra_actions:

364	            f' {{"{name}": {{...}}}}  {help_}' for name, (help_, _) in extra_actions.items())
365	    if page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
366	        start = _first_url(goal, task, site_id)
367	        if start:
368	            try:
369	                await page.goto(start, timeout=20000, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
370	            except Exception as error:
371	                log.debug("start url: %s", error)

374	    seen: set = set()

440	            user = (f"JOB:\n{goal}\n{hint_text}\n\nYOUR NOTES SO FAR:\n" + ("\n".join(memory[-8:]) or "(none)") +

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Save a run's full log locally as Markdown, so it can be read and searched without waiting for the platform.

  Writes .swarm/runs/<run>-log.md (whole log, replaced on every pull) and adds a line to .swarm/runs/<run>.md (notes:
  status, scores and MCP results go there). .swarm/ is git-ignored and never packaged: run logs hold scenario
  values, which must never get into the package.

.EXAMPLE
  .\scripts\pull-run.ps1 run_415bcaed321664dc            # once (run ended or a snapshot)
  .\scripts\pull-run.ps1 run_415bcaed321664dc -Follow    # keep writing until the run ends

  From Git Bash / a Claude Code Monitor:
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/pull-run.ps1 <run> -Follow
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$RunId,
    [switch]$Follow
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-Location (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)
$dir = ".swarm/runs"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null
$notes = "$dir/$RunId.md"
$logFile = "$dir/$RunId-log.md"
$now = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm 'UTC'")

# cmd merges stderr (atira writes progress there) without PowerShell 5.1 turning each line into an error record
$status = (cmd /c "atira status 2>&1" | Select-String -SimpleMatch $RunId | Select-Object -First 1)
$status = if ($status) { $status.Line.Trim() } else { "(not in atira status)" }

if (-not (Test-Path $notes)) {
    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $notes "# $RunId`n`nFull log: [$RunId-log.md]($RunId-log.md). Notes and MCP pulls below, newest last.`n"
}
Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $notes "`n## $now - log pulled`n`nStatus: $status`n"

# The platform keeps only the tail of a long log: a later pull can hold FEWER early lines than an earlier one. So the
# file is never replaced: lines it does not have yet are appended (in the order the platform returns them).
$known = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]'
if (Test-Path $logFile) {
{
  "setup": ["uv", "sync"],
  "run": ["uv", "run", "--no-sync", "python", "agent.py"],
  "browsers": 4,
  "models": ["qwen", "clef"]
}

commit f66a85f28fdab62472aefcee6bc13b953a6b44d0
Author: CRUBSTERINO <vperepelytsyn@gmail.com>
Date:   Sun Oct 11 06:29:32 2026 +0200

    Tab scheduler: parallel jobs run on whichever browser has room
    
    Every site used to own one browser; tender and spec finished early and two browsers sat idle while eight ERP
    tabs shared one. swarm/scheduler.py leases tabs on the least loaded browser (4 browses per browser, a browser
    already logged in to the site preferred, one login per browser and site at a time, released tabs pooled and
    reused). ERP jobs, mail topic tabs, the Q&A tab and coordinator follow-ups use it; ERP pre-warms two tabs and
    reads prices/stock of the first candidates next to their record. Sandbox run reh_def25b3b6ab5ef06: q 96.1 in
    10:06 (was 18:42 at the same quality).
    
    Also: never close a browser's last page (Chrome quits with it), page scripts bounded to 15 s, a tab keeps its
    browser session between browses (SWARM_REUSE_SESSIONS), get_signing_tan checks the summary itself, the TAN
    lookup clears a search via the URL, startup milestones and browse.connect spans, commitment material described
    in the mail extraction shape, local-run logging that tolerates a reader.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
    Entire-Checkpoint: 01M4MKJ89ZGEMNPPF46WZCAB8K

51	async def _main_then_exit() -> int:
52	    """main(), then a hard exit within 10 s: leftover tasks (guard loops, a pending TAN lookup, browser sessions) kept
53	    asyncio.run() from returning after the workflow had ended, so the run stayed 'running' until the platform's
54	    timeout (run_2746dd8a30f278e2: still running 10 min after 'Workflow failed')."""
55	    import os
56	    import threading
57	    code = await main()
58	    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
59	        stream.flush()
60	    timer = threading.Timer(10, os._exit, [code])
61	    timer.daemon = True
62	    timer.start()
63	    return code

import asyncio
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from agents.compute_bid import complete_for_signing  # noqa: E402
from swarm import orchestrator  # noqa: E402


class Board:
    def __init__(self, **values):
        self.values = values

    def get(self, key):
        return self.values.get(key)


FINAL = {"tender_final": True, "requirements_final": True, "mail_final": True, "done.mail": True}
COMPLETE = {"coverage": {"positions": 2, "complete": 2}, "unresolved": {}}


class EarlyEnd(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_a_complete_bid_with_tender_spec_and_mail_final_ends_collection(self):
        ctx = NS(board=Board(**FINAL), shared={})
        self.assertTrue(complete_for_signing(ctx, COMPLETE))
        self.assertFalse(complete_for_signing(ctx, {"coverage": {"positions": 2, "complete": 1}, "unresolved": {}}))
        self.assertFalse(complete_for_signing(ctx, {**COMPLETE, "unresolved": {"01": ["mail fx USD"]}}))
        self.assertFalse(complete_for_signing(ctx, {"coverage": {"positions": 0, "complete": 0}, "unresolved": {}}))
        for key in FINAL:                   # a site not analysed to the end may still change the bid
            board = Board(**{k: v for k, v in FINAL.items() if k != key})
            self.assertFalse(complete_for_signing(NS(board=board, shared={}), COMPLETE))

    def test_running_extraction_holds_collection(self):
        async def check():
            pending = asyncio.ensure_future(asyncio.sleep(5))
            ctx = NS(board=Board(**FINAL), shared={"background": {pending}})
            busy = complete_for_signing(ctx, COMPLETE)
            pending.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(pending, return_exceptions=True)
            return busy, complete_for_signing(ctx, COMPLETE)
        self.assertEqual(asyncio.run(check()), (False, True))

    def test_flag_ends_collecting_agents_only(self):
        async def check(collects):
            ctx = NS(shared={"collect_early_end": True}, time_left=lambda: 100.0)
            work = asyncio.ensure_future(asyncio.sleep(3, "finished"))
            await asyncio.wait_for(orchestrator._until_collect_ends(ctx, work, collects), 5)
            return work.cancelled()
        self.assertTrue(asyncio.run(check(True)))
        self.assertFalse(asyncio.run(check(False)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import asyncio
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from swarm.llm import LLM  # noqa: E402


class SlowClient:
    """Answers every call after `gate` opens; counts calls running at once."""
    def __init__(self, gate):
        self.gate, self.running, self.peak = gate, 0, 0
        self.chat = NS(completions=NS(create=self.create))

    async def create(self, **kwargs):
        self.running += 1
        self.peak = max(self.peak, self.running)
        await self.gate.wait()
        self.running -= 1
        return NS(usage=None, choices=[NS(message=NS(content="{}"))])


class Slots(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_browsing_steps_do_not_wait_for_analysis_slots(self):
        async def run():
            gate = asyncio.Event()
            llm = LLM(max_concurrent=6, analysis_concurrent=2)
            llm._client = SlowClient(gate)
            analysis = [asyncio.ensure_future(llm.ask("s", "u")) for _ in range(4)]
            browse = [asyncio.ensure_future(llm.ask("s", "u", analysis=False)) for _ in range(4)]
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            peak = llm._client.peak           # 2 analysis + 4 browsing at once (the total is 6)
            gate.set()
            await asyncio.gather(*analysis, *browse)
            return peak
        self.assertEqual(asyncio.run(run()), 6)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from swarm import lean  # noqa: E402

PAGE = """<select id=a><option>Bitte wählen</option><option>63</option></select>
<select id=b disabled><option>Bitte wählen</option><option>500</option></select>"""


class LeanSelect(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_disabled_select_is_refused_fast_and_enabled_one_selects(self):
        async def run():
            from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
                page = await browser.new_page()
                await page.set_content(PAGE)
                items, where = await lean.elements(page)
                ids = {e["label"][:12]: e["id"] for e in items}
                first, second = items[0]["id"], items[1]["id"]
                started = time.monotonic()
                refused, _ = await lean._act("select_dropdown", {"index": second, "text": "500"}, page, where, None,
                                             "", "test", None, "", None)
                took = time.monotonic() - started
                done, _ = await lean._act("select_dropdown", {"index": first, "text": "63"}, page, where, None,
                                          "", "test", None, "", None)
                value = await page.eval_on_selector("#a", "s => s.value")
                await browser.close()
                return refused, took, done, value, ids
        refused, took, done, value, _ = asyncio.run(run())
        self.assertIn("disabled", refused)
        self.assertLess(took, 4)
        self.assertEqual((done, value), ("selected", "63"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
